item.title: Gladwin County joins Michigan CWD deer list with confirmed case
item.description: DNR reported that a hunter-harvested deer in Gladwin County tested positive for CWD, meaning Michigan now has 18 counties with a positive case. In all, 376 CWD-positive deer have been confirmed in Michigan – that from roughly 148,800 tested deer. item.title: Proposal would up the cost of hunting, fishing licenses in Michigan
item.description: Will Michigan’s hunters and anglers face a higher tab for doing what they enjoy doing most? The question involves a staple of many wallets: the sturdy $5 bill. There are upsides and downsides to Gov. Gretchen Whitmer’s state budget proposal that would increase the cost of hunting, fishing and boating license fees. item.description: Nothing is more pleasing to me than spring otter trapping. item.title: Ryan Rothstein: Don’t underestimate the power of good deer moms
item.description: In my last column, I wrote a bit about a unique doe that I’ve been following for the past four years. She’s got a split left ear that you can’t miss, and she’s been a fun gal to follow ever since I first noticed it. She’s at least 5.5 years old based on my history with her, but she could easily be older. She’s been an interesting case study.
